content.text: Section 18 already contains the full coverage set. No redline needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 imposes on Vendor exactly the preferred coverage program: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law (plus employer's liability USD 1M), professional E&O at USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability at USD 5M (unconditional, which covers Vendor's hosting and processing of Customer Data under Sections 15 and 17), maintained through the term and one year afterward. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. All obligations run against the counterparty and meet or exceed the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
